decisions.name: Story stands alone without external paratext
decisions.audit_reason: Interpretive judgment of narrative self-sufficiency/completeness, a real editorial completeness criterion.

decisions.name: Implicit Worldbuilding
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether worldbuilding is dramatized versus expository lore-dumping; craft.

decisions.name: Controlled Repetition and Rhythm
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether repetition functions for meaning/pacing versus being accidental; craft.

decisions.name: Ending reframes what preceded rather than announcing closure
decisions.audit_reason: Judges structural craft of how the ending relates to the body of the story.

decisions.name: Voice With Control
decisions.audit_reason: Judges consistency and distinctiveness of prose voice; craft.

decisions.name: Interest built by the story, not borrowed from known material
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether piece adds original pressure/consequence beyond recognition, not mere presence of genre material.

decisions.name: Reaches real closure rather than an excerpt hook
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether the story reaches genuine resolution versus functioning as an excerpt; structural craft.

decisions.name: Non-Obvious Consequence
decisions.audit_reason: Judges plausibility and surprise of plot consequences; craft.

decisions.name: Detail that does work versus decorative inventory
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether concrete detail carries implicit meaning versus decorative inventory; craft.

decisions.name: Compression With Narrative Payoff
decisions.audit_reason: Judges efficiency and payoff of brevity; genuine craft of compression.

decisions.name: Premise as a Causal Engine
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses whether premise causally drives plot/character choices, a real construction/craft criterion.

decisions.name: Escalation Through Consequence
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether events causally escalate and narrow options; genuine plot-construction craft.

decisions.name: Dialogue With Subtext
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether dialogue conveys subtext and relationship; craft of dialogue writing.

decisions.name: Self-Implication in Character Desire
decisions.audit_reason: Judges depth and complexity of character motivation; craft of characterization.

sign_contradiction_reaudit.reason: Self-implicating desire is a substantive craft property editors prize (want vs. need), scorable from the text; a community favoring clear external goals explains the negative sign.

decisions.name: Form matches and amplifies content
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether structural form is a deliberate, meaning-carrying choice; craft.

sign_contradiction_reaudit.reason: Anchors enumerate form types, so judges effectively count formal unconventionality; excellent conventional linear prose scores low by construction. That is a stylistic habit, not quality evidence.

decisions.name: Self-promotional sign-off naming the author's own subreddit or handle
decisions.audit_reason: Counts promotional sign-off apparatus pointing at the author; platform furniture, not story quality.

decisions.name: Series-continuity residue
decisions.audit_reason: Mechanical count of serial/franchise markers; a platform/series fingerprint, not a quality judgment.

decisions.name: Non-standard spelling/grammar slips (unedited-draft marker)
decisions.audit_reason: Counts spelling/grammar slips as a marker of an unedited draft; production-process fingerprint, not craft.

decisions.name: Event-participation markers
decisions.audit_reason: Counts competition/event packaging labels; platform furniture, not story quality.

decisions.name: Fragmented staccato paragraphing / line-break repetition
decisions.audit_reason: Counts a formatting pattern (staccato line breaks) without judging whether it serves the story; stylistic fashion marker.

decisions.name: Immediate voice opening
decisions.audit_reason: Measures presence of a specific opening technique without judging its effect; stylistic/engagement pattern.

decisions.name: Borrowed recognisable characters or franchises doing the characterisation
decisions.audit_reason: Scores by identity of borrowed franchise characters rather than whether they're used well; genre/topic fingerprint.

decisions.name: Markup punctuation density
decisions.audit_reason: Counts typographic emphasis marks; surface formatting, not narrative quality.

decisions.name: Proper-noun token count
decisions.audit_reason: Counts capitalized proper nouns while explicitly ignoring world coherence; pure surface count.

decisions.name: Repeated-phrase exact-match count
decisions.audit_reason: Counts exact repeats, explicitly ignoring whether repetition is deliberate or rhetorical; surface form only.
